subject.title: fix(release): reuse exact evidence across candidate deltas

question: After the security defect is fixed and exact-head proof is complete, should the trusted-main release-delta evidence workflow become a supported permanent release path?
rationale: This changes which prior validation evidence may authorize package promotion, so implementation correctness cannot determine the intended long-term release trust policy.

options.title: Adopt after repair and proof
options.body: Accept the release-delta path after the injection fix, release-owner review, and successful exact-head end-to-end evidence.

options.title: Start changelog-only
options.body: Limit the first supported policy to changelog-only deltas and expand reuse after production release experience.

options.title: Keep full reruns
options.body: Continue requiring full release validation for every candidate SHA and do not add reusable evidence as a promotion gate.

recommendation.title: Adopt after repair and proof
recommendation.body: Accept the release-delta path after the injection fix, release-owner review, and successful exact-head end-to-end evidence.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history shows direct ownership of the release-publish and shared E2E contracts that define the permanent promotion boundary.
